product.title: Buffalo Trace Bourbon 750mL
product.body_html:
Heritage in every pour.
Buffalo Trace Bourbon is the flagship expression from the world-renowned Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky — one of the oldest continuously operating distilleries in the U.S. With a legacy that spans over 200 years, this small-batch bourbon is crafted using time-honored methods, aged in new oak barrels, and bottled at the peak of maturity.

Rich, complex, and deeply satisfying, Buffalo Trace delivers a smooth sipping experience with notes of vanilla, caramel, and spice, making it a favorite among connoisseurs, bartenders, and everyday bourbon drinkers alike.

This 750mL bottle is perfect for sipping neat, on the rocks, or mixed in classic cocktails like an Old Fashioned or Manhattan.

Key Features

  • Iconic bourbon from one of America’s most celebrated distilleries

  • Aged in new American oak barrels

  • Made using a centuries-old proprietary mash bill

  • Bottled at 90 proof for optimal smoothness and flavor

  • Widely awarded and critically acclaimed

  • Perfect for sipping or mixing

Product Details

  • Whiskey Type: Kentucky Straight Bourbon

  • ABV: 45% (90 Proof)

  • Volume: 750mL

  • Distillery: Buffalo Trace Distillery

  • Mash Bill: Undisclosed proprietary blend (rumored to include corn, rye, and malted barley)

  • Origin: Frankfort, Kentucky, USA

  • Packaging: Glass bottle with iconic buffalo label and green wax-sealed cap

  • Availability: Core product, full-time SKU

Tasting Notes

  • Appearance: Deep amber

  • Nose: Rich caramel, vanilla, mint, and molasses

  • Palate: Butterscotch, toffee, and spice with hints of dark fruit and leather

  • Finish: Long, smooth, with lingering notes of oak and vanilla

Food & Occasion Pairings

  • Pair With: BBQ brisket, grilled pork chops, dark chocolate, pecan pie

  • Occasions: Everyday sipping, cocktail making, holidays, gifting

  • Best Served: Neat, over ice, or in bourbon-based cocktails like a Boulevardier, Whiskey Sour, or Mint Julep

Buffalo Trace Bourbon: Tasting Summary

Buffalo Trace Bourbon is the flagship Kentucky straight bourbon from Buffalo Trace Distillery in Frankfort, Kentucky, one of America's oldest continuously operating distilleries. Bottled at 90 proof (45% ABV) in this 750mL bottle, it pours deep amber and delivers rich caramel, vanilla, mint, and molasses on the nose, with butterscotch, toffee, spice, and hints of dark fruit and leather on the palate, finishing long and smooth with oak and vanilla. Aged in new American oak barrels and widely awarded, Buffalo Trace Bourbon is equally at home sipped neat, poured over ice, or mixed into an Old Fashioned, Manhattan, or Whiskey Sour — a dependable everyday pour and an easy whiskey gift.

FAQs

Q: Is Buffalo Trace good for beginners?
Yes, its balanced sweetness and smooth profile make it an excellent bourbon for new drinkers.

Q: Is this the same mash bill as Eagle Rare or Blanton’s?
Buffalo Trace shares a similar (if not identical) mash bill with several of its premium sibling bourbons, but each is aged differently and selected uniquely.

Q: Is Buffalo Trace allocated?
Availability varies by region due to high demand, but it’s considered a full-time SKU.

Q: How should I store it?
Store upright in a cool, dark place. Once opened, it’s best consumed within 1–2 years.
